purpose: Durable record of the authorized lean repository retention pass before production asset release.

scope.includedIntegrationEvidenceSnapshot: Only the 55 pre-existing files represented by the external integration-evidence archive; per-asset Chase captures were removed, while Classic and Modern captures were retained.
scope.concurrentIntegrationNote: The primary is writing new cargo-kit and covered-fighter integration evidence. Those directories were not enumerated, archived, trimmed, or included in the retained checksum list.
scope.productionApprovalNote: The user authorized this retention cleanup. Default production approval does not mean Opus review or final art acceptance is complete.

retainedSHA256SUMS.covers: All files in the 21 current initial trees, including each per-initial RETENTION.md and retainedSHA256SUMS, plus exactly the 38 pre-existing integration-evidence files preserved from the verified archive. It excludes this global checksum file, retention.json, DEVLOG.md, cargo-kit/covered-fighter integration folders, and paths outside scope.

externalArchiveIndices.scope: 19 asset initial archives and pre-existing integration-evidence snapshot

preExistingIntegrationEvidenceSnapshot.snapshotNote: Archived before the primary started writing new cargo-kit and covered-fighter integration evidence.

retentionPolicy.kept: Original packed editable blends and GLBs, runtime templates/maps, manifests, original SHA256SUMS, source snapshots, generator/build/verification/runtime-recipe scripts, every non-log textual protocol/review record and JSON report, and 3-5 selected original PNGs per asset.
retentionPolicy.removed: Unselected PNG renders/component frames and raw .log files from the initial trees, plus 17 repeated Chase captures from the pre-existing integration-evidence snapshot. Every omitted initial and integration path is listed with its original SHA256 and byte count.
retentionPolicy.reproduction: Core authoring binaries, generator/runtime sources, JSON reports, QA source fixtures, and verification code remain byte-identical. Full initial render/contact-sheet reproduction may require omitted PNG frames or logs; restore that asset’s complete initial-tree archive into a writable copy before running evidence scripts. Restore the original pre-existing integration captures from the separate integration-evidence archive. Do not run generators in retained initial directories.
retentionPolicy.historicalChecksumNote: Each original initial/SHA256SUMS is preserved unchanged and describes its full pre-trim initial tree. It is expected not to verify the lean copy because omitted original files are absent. Each initial directory now has a separate retainedSHA256SUMS and RETENTION.md.
